jobs.name: 混色シンボル
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Game: COLOR TRACE, an existing casual drawing puzzle. Red and blue paths travel through square tiles. Where red and blue occupy the same tile or segment, the mixed result is PURPLE.
Input image 1: visual style reference, selected stage UI. Input image 2: visual style reference and original COLOR TRACE wordmark. These are references for a NEW marketing asset, not edit targets.
Visual family: selected B / 2D Toon Bold. Bright sky blue background (#2EB9EF), warm cream (#FFF6D8), ink navy (#071B52), coral red (#FF3E43), cobalt blue (#0068FF), violet purple (#8A25F5). Strong crisp navy keylines, chunky rounded forms, flat solid color fills, a single restrained flat offset graphic shadow. Friendly polished illustrated US casual puzzle store creative. NOT a 3D render. No realistic textures, gradients, glossy sheen, bevels or dimensional plastic. Match the references' memorable blue/cream/navy palette and silhouette language.
Constraints: original game branding only; no borrowed logos, characters or mascots. No hands or devices. No app store badges, ratings, medals, crowns, currency, hearts, buttons, UI controls, watermarks, claims, prices, or additional mechanics. End points are simple solid circles. Paths make orthogonal rounded 90-degree turns, never diagonal or messy squiggles. Overlap is purple, not a red line crossing on top of an intact blue line. Keep the design clean enough for small mobile store display.
Asset type: app icon, full bleed square 1024 x 1024 PNG. One single asset, no presentation board, no surrounding border or labels.
Primary request: a bold instantly recognizable MIX SYMBOL app icon. Enlarge and simplify the title reference's three-tile mixing motif.
Composition: three oversized cream rounded square game tiles with thick navy outlines, arranged as a tight inverted triangle, red origin tile at upper left and blue origin tile at upper right, one purple result tile below in the center. A thick coral red right-angle route from its large red starting dot and a thick cobalt blue right-angle route from its blue starting dot meet at the top of the lower central tile. At their junction they become a single clean purple segment finishing in a large purple dot. The resulting two-to-one Y silhouette is built from ONLY orthogonal rounded routes, not literal diagonal Y branches. Three tiles form one strong compact centered emblem; generous 9 percent safe margin all around, bold symbol occupies 80 percent of canvas. Pure vivid sky-blue full square background, two tiny subdued pale cyan cloud silhouettes only near outer edges. Cream tiles, red blue purple routing, all very readable at 48 pixels.
Text: absolutely NO TEXT or letters.
Avoid: a miniature full gameplay screen, tiny grids, 3D tube connectors, a drop shadow outside the full icon square, pre-rounded outer icon corners, multiple icon variants in one image.
